issues.detail: The instructions do not cover all possible error scenarios and edge cases.

scenarios.name: clean-inventory-and-summarize-by-category
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers more rubric items (dtype, assign, named aggregation, fillna) than Response A, though both miss .pipe() and drop_duplicates.

scenarios.name: merge-customer-transactions-and-export
scenarios.rationale: Both responses omit the required validate='one_to_many' and .pipe() chaining, but Response A includes more explicit steps and named aggregation, giving it a slightly higher score.

scenarios.name: monthly-average-temperature-from-parquet
scenarios.rationale: Response A better meets the rubric by using ME resampling and a more complete pipeline, though it still lacks .pipe(), fillna(), and column renaming; Response B misses ME, .pipe(), fillna(), and renaming.
